input.text: The schedule continues Parts 5 to 7 of that Act.

_note: The trailing-anaphora consumer must extend the span even when the nearest mention of the declared type is NOT the host, so a non-host 'of that Act' right after a pinpoint-bearing plural chain stays in the SAME reference as its own 'Parts 5 to 7' pinpoint, never a SECOND, separate item with no pinpoint of its own.
